notes: New going-concern and covenant language. Unambiguous escalation.

variables.prior_text: We operate in a cyclical industry and our results are affected by construction activity. Our indebtedness could adversely affect our financial flexibility. We depend on a limited number of suppliers for certain raw materials. We are subject to environmental regulations that may require capital expenditures.
variables.current_text: We operate in a cyclical industry and our results are affected by construction activity. Our indebtedness could adversely affect our financial flexibility. As of June 30, 2026 we were not in compliance with the consolidated leverage ratio covenant under our senior credit facility, and we have obtained a temporary waiver expiring December 31, 2026. If we are unable to negotiate an amendment or refinance the facility, our lenders could accelerate the outstanding borrowings, and there would be substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern. We depend on a limited number of suppliers for certain raw materials. We are subject to environmental regulations that may require capital expenditures.

notes: TRAP: pure re-wording and reordering, zero substantive change. The most common false-positive source — models want to find something.

variables.prior_text: We face intense competition in all of our markets, which could reduce our margins. Our business depends on attracting and retaining qualified personnel. Interruptions in our supply chain could harm our operations. Changes in tax law could increase our effective tax rate.
variables.current_text: Our business depends on attracting and retaining qualified personnel. Changes in tax law could increase our effective tax rate. We encounter significant competition across each of our markets, which may compress our margins. Disruptions affecting our supply chain could adversely affect our operations.

notes: Language shifts from hypothetical to actual — 'could result in' becomes 'has resulted in' with a named investigation.

variables.prior_text: We are subject to extensive healthcare regulation. Failure to comply with applicable billing and coding requirements could result in government investigations, civil monetary penalties, or exclusion from federal healthcare programs, any of which could adversely affect our business.
variables.current_text: We are subject to extensive healthcare regulation. On September 12, 2026 we received a Civil Investigative Demand from the United States Department of Justice pursuant to the False Claims Act, requesting documents relating to our outpatient billing practices from 2021 through 2025. We are cooperating with the investigation. An adverse outcome could result in civil monetary penalties, treble damages, or exclusion from federal healthcare programs, and we have recorded a $45 million accrual representing our current estimate of probable loss.

notes: Newly named customer concentration. Material but not existential.

variables.prior_text: We sell our products through a variety of retail channels including mass merchandisers, club stores, grocery, and e-commerce. The loss of a significant customer could adversely affect our results of operations.
variables.current_text: We sell our products through a variety of retail channels including mass merchandisers, club stores, grocery, and e-commerce. One customer accounted for approximately 24% of our net sales in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and that customer has notified us that it intends to reduce shelf space allocated to two of our largest brands beginning in the first quarter of 2027. The loss or further reduction of this customer relationship would have a material adverse effect on our results of operations.

notes: Genuine easing — a resolved litigation risk removed. Rare in practice, which is exactly why it belongs in the set: models that always answer bearish must be caught.

variables.prior_text: We are a defendant in patent infringement litigation brought by Astra Devices in the Eastern District of Texas seeking damages and an injunction against the sale of our accelerator products. An injunction, if granted, would prevent us from selling products representing a majority of our revenue. We may also be required to pay substantial damages or ongoing royalties. Our results depend on demand for data center accelerators.
variables.current_text: On May 30, 2026 we entered into a settlement and cross-license agreement with Astra Devices resolving all outstanding patent litigation between the parties, including a full release of claims and dismissal with prejudice of the Eastern District of Texas action. The settlement did not require a material payment by the Company and no injunction was entered. Our results depend on demand for data center accelerators.

notes: TRAP: boilerplate regulatory citation update (a new named statute) that changes no substantive exposure. Tests that 'new words' is not read as 'new risk'.

variables.prior_text: Our operations are subject to extensive federal, state and local regulation, including environmental regulation administered by the Environmental Protection Agency. Compliance with existing and future environmental requirements may require significant capital expenditures and operating costs.
variables.current_text: Our operations are subject to extensive federal, state and local regulation, including environmental regulation administered by the Environmental Protection Agency under the Clean Air Act, the Clean Water Act, and the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act. Compliance with existing and future environmental requirements, including any regulations promulgated under these statutes, may require significant capital expenditures and operating costs.

notes: Newly disclosed material weakness in internal control.

variables.prior_text: We depend on information technology systems to manage our freight network. A failure of these systems could disrupt our operations. We face driver shortages and rising wage costs. Fuel price volatility affects our operating expenses.
variables.current_text: We depend on information technology systems to manage our freight network. A failure of these systems could disrupt our operations. In connection with the preparation of our financial statements, management identified a material weakness in our internal control over financial reporting relating to the review of gross versus net revenue presentation for brokerage arrangements. As a result, management concluded that our internal control over financial reporting was not effective as of December 31, 2025. We face driver shortages and rising wage costs. Fuel price volatility affects our operating expenses.

notes: New single-geography concentration risk with a quantified exposure.

variables.prior_text: We derive revenue from commercial and defense aerospace customers across multiple geographies. Changes in defense spending priorities could reduce demand for our products. Our long-term contracts expose us to cost estimation risk.
variables.current_text: We derive revenue from commercial and defense aerospace customers across multiple geographies. Approximately 38% of our second quarter revenue was generated from a single narrowbody program, and any delay, rate reduction, or cancellation of that program by the airframer would have a disproportionate effect on our results. The airframer has publicly indicated it is evaluating its production rate plan for 2027. Changes in defense spending priorities could reduce demand for our products.
